item.text:
Provides order helpers: totals item prices/quantities, applies codes, calculates an average, and formats an order receipt.

Bugs:
- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`, so its last iteration reads `items[items.length]` and throws (`undefined.price`). Use `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice` divides the order total by item count, not total quantity; its name is ambiguous/wrong if it means per-unit average.
- `averageItemPrice([])` returns `NaN` (and currently throws first because of `calcTotal`).
